exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture. Who's Tony's father? mother? grandfather? grandmother? sister? brother?
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang. Tonining otasi kim? onasi? bobosi? buvisi? singlisi? ukasi?
exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT MAVZUSI — OILA.

Sarlavha 'Like Father, like Son' — inglizcha maqol.
So'zma-so'z: 'Ota qanday bo'lsa, o'g'il ham shunday.'
Ma'nosi: bola ota-onasiga o'xshaydi.
O'zbekchada: 'Olma daraxtidan uzoqqa tushmaydi.'

OILA A'ZOLARI:
  father / dad       — ota
  mother / mum       — ona
  parents            — ota-ona
  grandfather / grandad — bobo
  grandmother / granny  — buvi
  grandparents       — bobo va buvi
  brother            — aka yoki uka
  sister             — opa yoki singil
  son                — o'g'il
  daughter           — qiz

DIQQAT: ingliz tilida AKA va UKA farqlanmaydi — ikkalasi ham 'brother'.
Kerak bo'lsa 'older brother' (katta aka) yoki 'younger brother' (uka)
deb aniqlashtiriladi. Opa/singil ham shunday: 'sister'.

exercises.instructionEn: Describe the people in the picture.
exercises.explanationUz:
Unit 2 da o'rganilgan odam tasvirlash tili qayta ishlatiladi.

QOLIP:
  X is + yosh/bo'y sifati + WITH + soch/ko'z.
  Joe is tall with short dark hair.

KERAKLI SO'ZLAR:
  bo'y:  tall (baland), short (past)
  gavda: slim (nozik), fat (to'la)
  yosh:  young (yosh), old (keksa), middle-aged (o'rta yoshli)
  soch:  short/long, dark/fair/grey/white, straight/curly
  ko'z:  brown, blue, green eyes

DIQQAT — 'hair' HECH QACHON ko'plikda ishlatilmaydi:
  ✅ short dark hair
  ❌ short dark hairs

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in niece, grandmother, wife, sister, daughter or aunt, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: niece, grandmother, wife, sister, daughter yoki aunt — birini yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
ERKAK ↔ AYOL qarindoshlik juftliklari.

Har bir erkak qarindoshning ayol jufti bor:
  husband     ↔ wife         (er ↔ xotin)
  son         ↔ daughter     (o'g'il ↔ qiz)
  uncle       ↔ aunt         (amaki/tog'a ↔ amma/xola)
  nephew      ↔ niece        (jiyan o'g'il ↔ jiyan qiz)
  brother     ↔ sister       (aka/uka ↔ opa/singil)
  grandfather ↔ grandmother  (bobo ↔ buvi)
  father      ↔ mother
  grandson    ↔ granddaughter

O'ZBEK TILI BILAN FARQ:
O'zbekchada amaki (otaning akasi) va tog'a (onaning akasi)
farqlanadi. Inglizchada IKKALASI ham 'uncle'.
Shunday: amma va xola — ikkalasi 'aunt'.

TALAFFUZ QIYIN so'zlar:
  niece  /niːs/    — 'niis' (nayes EMAS)
  nephew /ˈnefjuː/ — 'NEF-yu'
  aunt   /ɑːnt/    — 'aant' (Britaniyada)

tasks.whyUz: o'g'il ↔ qiz (farzand). O'qilishi 'DOO-ta' — 'gh' o'qilmaydi.
amaki/tog'a ↔ amma/xola.
jiyan (o'g'il) ↔ jiyan (qiz).
aka/uka ↔ opa/singil.
bobo ↔ buvi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing days of the week, then listen and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Hafta kunlarining tushib qolganini yozing, so'ng tinglab takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAFTA KUNLARI — Britaniyada hafta DUSHANBADAN boshlanadi.

  1 Monday    — dushanba
  2 Tuesday   — seshanba
  3 Wednesday — chorshanba
  4 Thursday  — payshanba
  5 Friday    — juma
  6 Saturday  — shanba
  7 Sunday    — yakshanba

MUHIM QOIDA — hafta kunlari HAR DOIM KATTA HARF bilan:
  ✅ Monday   ❌ monday
Bu o'zbek tilida yo'q qoida, shuning uchun ko'p unutiladi.

QISQARTMALAR: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun

TALAFFUZ TUZOQLARI:
  Wednesday /ˈwenzdeɪ/ — 'WENZ-dey'. O'rtadagi 'd' O'QILMAYDI!
  Tuesday   /ˈtjuːzdeɪ/ — 'TYUUZ-dey'
  Thursday  /ˈθɜːzdeɪ/  — 'THOOZ-dey', til tishlar orasida

KUNLAR BILAN PREDLOG — ON:
  on Monday — dushanba kuni
  on Saturdays — har shanba (ko'plikda = har hafta)

tasks.whyUz: seshanba. Ro'yxatda berilgan uch so'zdan biri.
juma. Shanbadan oldin keladi.
yakshanba. Britaniyada haftaning OXIRGI kuni.

exercises.instructionUz: Yuqoridagi mashg'ulotlar ro'yxati va quyidagi fe'llar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT DARAJALI YOQTIRISH SHKALASI:

  love (♥♥)      — juda yaxshi ko'raman
  like (♥)       — yoqtiraman
  don't like (✗) — yoqtirmayman
  hate (✗✗)      — yomon ko'raman

QOIDA: bu fe'llardan keyin ikkinchi fe'l -ING oladi:
  I love reading.        (I love read EMAS)
  I don't like camping.  (I don't like camp EMAS)

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA — ikki xil bog'lash usuli:
  1) I like fishing and I love reading. I don't like camping THOUGH.
     ('though' alohida gapning oxirida)
  2) I like fishing and I love reading, BUT I don't like camping.
     ('but' ikki gapni bog'laydi, oldidan vergul)

Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri va bir xil ma'noni beradi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read Tony's letter and explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Tonining xatini o'qing va qalin yozilgan so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
XAT TUZILISHI (4 xatboshi):
  1) O'zi haqida: ism, yosh, kasb, tashqi ko'rinish
  2) Oilasi: kim bor, ota-onaning kasbi, uy
  3) Bo'sh vaqti: nimani yoqtiradi, nimani yoqtirmaydi
  4) Yakun: javob so'rash

Bu tuzilma o'zingiz haqingizda yozish uchun ham NAMUNA.
Qalin so'zlar — 4c mashqida tushuntirilishi kerak bo'lgan so'zlar.

tasks.en: Dear Pierre,
tasks.uz: Hurmatli Pyer,
tasks.note: Do'stona xat boshi. Ismdan keyin VERGUL qo'yiladi (nuqta emas).

tasks.en: I'm Tony Philips and I'm seventeen years old.
tasks.uz: Men Toni Filipsman va o'n yetti yoshdaman.
tasks.note: Yosh: 'I'm 17 years old' yoki qisqacha 'I'm 17'. 'I have 17 years' NOTO'G'RI.

tasks.en: I'm a student and I live in Montreal, Canada.
tasks.uz: Men talabaman va Monrealda, Kanadada yashayman.
tasks.note: QALIN SO'Z: live = yashamoq. Shahar va mamlakat bilan IN.

tasks.en: I'm tall and slim with short dark hair and brown eyes.
tasks.uz: Men baland bo'yli va nozikman, sochim kalta va to'q rangli, ko'zlarim jigarrang.
tasks.note: Tashqi ko'rinish qolipi: I'm + sifat + WITH + soch va ko'z.

tasks.en: There are seven of us in our family; my grandparents, Steve and Sally, my parents, Joe and Kate, my sister, Liz, aged nine, my brother, Leo, aged six, and of course, me.
tasks.uz: Oilamizda yetti kishimiz: bobom va buvim Stiv va Salli, ota-onam Jou va Keyt, to'qqiz yoshli singlim Liz, olti yoshli ukam Leo va, albatta, men.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: grandparents = bobo va buvi; parents = ota-ona; aged = ...yoshli; of course = albatta.
Nuqtali vergul (;) ro'yxatni boshlaydi.

tasks.en: My father is a surgeon.
tasks.uz: Otam jarroh.
tasks.note: QALIN SO'Z: surgeon = jarroh (operatsiya qiluvchi shifokor). Kasb oldida 'a' SHART.

tasks.en: He works at the local hospital and my mother is a teacher in a primary school.
tasks.uz: U mahalliy kasalxonada ishlaydi, onam esa boshlang'ich maktabda o'qituvchi.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: local hospital = mahalliy kasalxona; primary school = boshlang'ich maktab (5–11 yosh).
'work AT' — muassasada ishlamoq.

tasks.en: We live in a big house about twenty minutes from the city centre.
tasks.uz: Biz shahar markazidan taxminan yigirma daqiqa masofadagi katta uyda yashaymiz.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'Z: city centre = shahar markazi.
'about' = taxminan. Masofa VAQT bilan ham o'lchanadi.

tasks.en: In my free time, I love playing computer games and listening to rock music.
tasks.uz: Bo'sh vaqtimda kompyuter o'yinlari o'ynashni va rok musiqa tinglashni yaxshi ko'raman.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'Z: free time = bo'sh vaqt.
MUHIM: 'love/like' dan keyin fe'l -ING oladi: love PLAYING, like LISTENING.

tasks.en: I'm an MTV maniac.
tasks.uz: Men MTV ishqibozi (jinnisi) man.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'Z: maniac = biror narsaga o'ta berilgan odam.
MTV — musiqa telekanali. 'an MTV' — 'em-ti-vi' unli tovush bilan boshlanadi.

tasks.en: My favourite group is Guns'n'Roses. Do you like them?
tasks.uz: Eng sevimli guruhim — Guns'n'Roses. Sen ularni yoqtirasanmi?
tasks.note: 'them' — obyekt olmoshi (1-epizodda o'rganildi).

tasks.en: I also like going to the cinema. I go to the cinema every Saturday.
tasks.uz: Yana kinoga borishni yoqtiraman. Har shanba kinoga boraman.
tasks.note: 'also' = yana, shuningdek. 'every Saturday' = har shanba.

tasks.en: I don't like going to the theatre, though.
tasks.uz: Teatrga borishni esa yoqtirmayman.
tasks.note: 'though' gap OXIRIDA — 'lekin, esa' ma'nosida. Og'zaki nutqda ko'p ishlatiladi.

tasks.en: Well, that's all about me.
tasks.uz: Xo'sh, men haqimda shuncha.
tasks.note: Xatni yakunlashga o'tish iborasi.

tasks.en: Write back and tell me about yourself.
tasks.uz: Javob yozing va o'zingiz haqingizda gapirib bering.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: write back = javob yozmoq; yourself = o'zing.
Ikkalasi ham BUYRUQ shaklida (1-epizod grammatikasi).

tasks.en: Best wishes, Tony
tasks.uz: Ezgu tilaklar bilan, Toni
tasks.note: Do'stona xat oxiri. Vergul, keyin yangi qatorda ism.

exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOL TURLARI:

  'What does X look like?' — TASHQI KO'RINISH so'raladi.
  DIQQAT: 'What is X like?' — XARAKTER yoki umumiy tavsif.
  Farqi:
    What does he look like? — He is tall with dark hair. (ko'rinishi)
    What is he like?        — He is kind and funny. (xarakteri)

  'What does X like doing?' — nimani yoqtiradi.
  Bu yerda 'like' — 'yoqtirmoq' fe'li (kabi emas!).

tasks.answer: He is tall and slim with short dark hair and brown eyes.
tasks.whyUz: Xatning birinchi xatboshisidan. 'look like' — tashqi ko'rinish.

tasks.answer: She is a teacher in a primary school.
tasks.whyUz: Xatda: 'my mother is a teacher in a primary school'.

tasks.answer: It is in Montreal, Canada, about twenty minutes from the city centre.
tasks.whyUz: Manzil: 43, St Catherine Street, Montreal. Xatda: 'about twenty minutes from the city centre'.

tasks.answer: He likes playing computer games, listening to rock music and going to the cinema.
tasks.whyUz: Uchta mashg'ulot. 'like' dan keyin fe'l -ING oladi.

tasks.prompt: 4  What does Tony not like doing?
tasks.answer: He doesn't like going to the theatre.
tasks.whyUz: Xatda: 'I don't like going to the theatre, though.'
tasks.speak: 4  What does Tony not like doing?

tasks.whyUz: Do'stona xat 'Dear + ism' bilan boshlanadi.
Do'stona xat 'Best wishes' yoki 'Love' bilan tugaydi.

exercises.explanationUz: Xatdagi 13 ta qalin so'z — Unit 4 ning asosiy lug'ati.

tasks.whyUz: I live in Montreal.
grand + parents. Bitta so'z bilan aytiladi.
Doim ko'plikda. Bittasi — 'a parent'.
my sister, Liz, aged nine — to'qqiz yoshli singlim Liz.
Ikki so'z. 'ofkos' deb o'qiladi.
Operatsiya qiladigan shifokor. O'qilishi 'SO-jen'.
local = o'sha joydagi, mahalliy.
5–11 yoshdagilar uchun. Keyingisi — secondary school.
AQShda 'downtown' deyiladi.
'spare time' ham deyiladi.
an MTV maniac — MTV ishqibozi. Salbiy emas, hazil ohangda.
'back' — javoban degani. call back = qayta qo'ng'iroq qilmoq.
self olmoshi. myself, yourself, himself, herself...

exercises.instructionEn: Read the examples and study the rules, then underline the correct items in the sentences below.
exercises.instructionUz: Namunalar va qoidalarni o'rganing, so'ng quyidagi gaplarda to'g'ri variantni tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir gapda IKKI SAVOL bering:
  1) Ega BITTAMI yoki KO'PMI?
  2) Apostrof kerakmi?

Egalik bor bo'lsa — apostrof SHART.
Ega bitta bo'lsa 's, ko'p bo'lsa (va -s bilan tugasa) s'.

tasks.whyUz: Bitta o'g'il (birlik) → 's. 'sons' — apostrofsiz, u shunchaki ko'plik (o'g'illar).
Ism ham birlik ot — egalik uchun 's shart.
Ikki egasi, BITTA uy → 's faqat OXIRGI ismga qo'shiladi.
Bitta odam → 's.
Ko'plik va -s bilan tugaydi → faqat apostrof: boys'.

exercises.explanationUz:
Qoidani mustahkamlash uchun qo'shimcha mashq.
Har birida ot birlikmi-ko'plikmi ekaniga qarang.

tasks.whyUz: Birlik → 's. Tartib teskari bo'ladi: ega + narsa.
Ko'plik, -s bilan tugaydi → faqat apostrof.

tasks.prompt: the mother of Ann and John →
tasks.whyUz: Ikki egasi, bitta ona → 's oxirgi ismga.
tasks.speak: the mother of Ann and John →

tasks.whyUz: 'parents' ko'plik va -s bilan tugaydi → s'.
'children' ko'plik, lekin -s bilan TUGAMAYDI → 's qo'shiladi.
Ism birlik → 's.
Ko'plik -s bilan → s'.
Vaqt bilan ham 's ishlatiladi.

rule.explanationUz:
Ingliz tilida egalik APOSTROF bilan ko'rsatiladi.
O'zbekchadagi '-ning' qo'shimchasiga o'xshaydi, lekin joyi teskari:

  o'zbekcha: bola-NING to'pi
  inglizcha: the BOY'S ball

DIQQAT — tartib TESKARI:
  the boy's ball = bolaning to'pi
  EGA birinchi, NARSA keyin. O'zbekchada ham shunday, lekin
  'ning' o'rniga apostrof va 's' ishlatiladi.

APOSTROF QAYERGA QO'YILADI — bu butun qoidaning MAG'ZI:
  ot BIRLIK bo'lsa      → 's   (the boy's)
  ot KO'PLIK va -s bilan tugasa → s'   (the girls')

TALAFFUZDA FARQI YO'Q: 'boys' va 'boy's' va 'boys'' —
uchalasi bir xil eshitiladi. Faqat YOZUVDA farqlanadi.

rules.enRule: We add 's when a noun is singular to show possession.

rules.uzRule: Ot KO'PLIK va -s bilan tugasa — faqat apostrof (') qo'shiladi.
rules.enRule: We add ' when a noun is plural and ends in -s to show possession.

rules.uzRule: Ikki (yoki undan ko'p) egasi bo'lsa — 's FAQAT OXIRGISIGA qo'shiladi.
rules.enRule: We add 's to the last noun of a phrase to show possession.
examples: This is Ann and John's mother.

rule.warningUz:
ENG KO'P XATO — apostrofni unutish yoki noto'g'ri joyga qo'yish:

  ❌ my sons bicycle    ✅ my son's bicycle     (bitta o'g'il)
  ❌ the boys bicycles  ✅ the boys' bicycles   (bir nechta bola)
  ❌ Jenny desk         ✅ Jenny's desk
  ❌ Tony's and Pam's house  ✅ Tony and Pam's house (bitta uy, ikki egasi)

DIQQAT: 'Tony's and Pam's houses' — bu BOSHQA ma'no:
Toninining uyi va Pamning uyi (ikkita alohida uy).
rule.noteUz:
KO'PLIK -s siz bo'lsa, 's qo'shiladi:
  children → the children's room  (bolalar xonasi)
  men      → the men's room
  women    → the women's team
  people   → the people's choice

Chunki bu so'zlar -s bilan tugamaydi.
rule.extraUz:
's QACHON ISHLATILADI:
  ✅ ODAM va hayvon uchun: Tony's book, the dog's tail
  ✅ vaqt uchun: today's newspaper, a week's holiday
  ✅ mamlakat/shahar uchun: Canada's cities

JONSIZ narsalar uchun odatda 'of' ishlatiladi:
  ✅ the door OF the house (uyning eshigi)
  ⚠️ the house's door — grammatik to'g'ri, lekin tabiiy emas

Va yodda tuting: it's ≠ its
  it's = it is (u ...dir)
  its  = uning (egalik, apostrof YO'Q!)

exercises.instructionEn: Read the letter again and complete the table. Then, look at your notes and talk about Tony. Start like this: Tony Philips is seventeen years old. ...
exercises.instructionUz: Xatni qayta o'qing va jadvalni to'ldiring. So'ng qaydlaringizga qarab Toni haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL SARLAVHALARI — odam haqida gapirishning STANDART tartibi:

  FULL NAME       — to'liq ism
  AGE/OCCUPATION  — yosh va kasb
  CITY/COUNTRY    — shahar va mamlakat
  APPEARANCE      — tashqi ko'rinish
  FAMILY MEMBERS  — oila a'zolari
  HOME            — uy
  LIKES/LOVES     — nimani yoqtiradi

Shu tartibda o'zingiz haqingizda ham gapira olasiz.

Kitob berilgan boshlanish: 'Tony Philips is seventeen years old. ...'

tasks.answer: His full name is Tony Philips.
Tony Philips is seventeen years old and he is a student.
tasks.whyUz: Kitob shu gap bilan boshlashni taklif qiladi.

tasks.answer: He is tall and slim with short dark hair and brown eyes.
There are seven people in his family. His grandparents are Steve and Sally.
His parents are Joe, a surgeon, and Kate, a teacher.
He has got a sister, Liz, aged nine, and a brother, Leo, aged six.
He lives at 43, St Catherine Street, in a big house about twenty minutes from the city centre.
He loves playing computer games and listening to rock music.
He also likes going to the cinema and he goes there every Saturday.
He doesn't like going to the theatre, though.

wordFormation.ruleUz: grand- oldi qo'shimchasi — bir avlod uzoq
wordFormation.explanationUz: 'grand-' qo'shilsa, qarindoshlik bir avlod uzoqlashadi. 'great-' qo'shilsa — yana bir avlod.
Bu fe'llardan keyin ikkinchi fe'l -ING qo'shimchasini oladi. Bu Unit 4 ning asosiy grammatikasi.
'O'zim, o'zing, o'zi' ma'nosini beradi. Ega bilan to'ldiruvchi bir xil odam bo'lganda ishlatiladi.
Bu betdagi kasblar. Kasb oldida DOIM a/an turadi.
Fe'lga 'back' qo'shilsa, 'javob sifatida' ma'nosi paydo bo'ladi.
Ingliz tilida ko'p qarindoshlik so'zlari juft bo'lib keladi. Juftlik bilan yodlash osonroq.
Kun nomlari qadimgi xudolar va sayyoralar nomidan kelib chiqqan. Hammasi KATTA HARF bilan yoziladi.
Fe'lga -ing qo'shilsa, u 'shu ishni qilish' ma'nosini beradi va otdek ishlatiladi.
Apostrof joyi ot birlikmi-ko'plikmi ekaniga bog'liq.
Eng kuchlidan eng kuchsizgacha to'rt daraja.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'm + ism and I'm + yosh + years old.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm Tony Philips and I'm seventeen years old.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men Toni Filipsman va o'n yetti yoshdaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Yosh 'BE' fe'li bilan aytiladi: I AM 17.
'I have 17 years' — NOTO'G'RI (bu o'zbek/rus tilidan ta'sir).

sentencePatterns.formula: I'm + bo'y/gavda + WITH + soch + and + ko'z.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm tall and slim with short dark hair and brown eyes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men baland bo'yli va nozikman, sochim kalta va to'q rangli, ko'zlarim jigarrang.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Tartib: bo'y → gavda → WITH → soch → ko'z.
'hair' birlikda, 'eyes' ko'plikda.

sentencePatterns.formula: There are + son + of us in our family.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There are seven of us in our family.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'of us' — 'bizdan'. Oila a'zolari sonini aytishning tabiiy usuli.
Qisqa tanishtirish. Ism ikki vergul orasida, keyin 'aged + son'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He works at the local hospital.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Muassasa bilan AT: at the hospital, at the school, at a bank.
Muassasa TURINI aytganda IN: a teacher IN a primary school.

sentencePatterns.formula: In my free time, I love/like + fe'l-ING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In my free time, I love playing computer games and listening to rock music.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bo'sh vaqtimda kompyuter o'yinlari o'ynashni va musiqa tinglashni yaxshi ko'raman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
like/love/enjoy dan keyin fe'l -ING oladi.
  ✅ I like going.   ❌ I like go.   ❌ I like to going.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I don't like going to the theatre, though.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'though' gap oxirida — oldingi fikrga qarshi ma'no qo'shadi.
Oldidan vergul qo'yiladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is the boy's ball. This is Jenny's desk.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu bolaning to'pi. Bu Jennining stoli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Birlik ot bilan 's. Ega birinchi, narsa keyin.
Ko'plik -s bilan tugasa, faqat apostrof qo'shiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: ISM and ISM's + narsa (bitta narsa, ikki egasi).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is Ann and John's mother.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 's faqat OXIRGI ismga. Ikkalasiga qo'ysangiz — ikkita alohida ona degani bo'ladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I love / like / don't like / hate + fe'l-ING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I like fishing and I love reading. I don't like camping though.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Baliq ovlashni yoqtiraman va kitob o'qishni yaxshi ko'raman. Chodirda dam olishni esa yoqtirmayman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bu to'rt fe'ldan keyin ikkinchi fe'l DOIM -ING oladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I like fishing and I love reading, but I don't like camping.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Baliq ovlashni yoqtiraman va kitob o'qishni yaxshi ko'raman, lekin chodirda dam olishni yoqtirmayman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'but' bilan qarama-qarshi fikr. Vergul 'but' dan OLDIN qo'yiladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I go to the cinema on Saturday. / I play football on Mondays.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shanba kuni kinoga boraman. / Dushanba kunlari futbol o'ynayman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Kun bilan ON. Ko'plikda (on Mondays) — 'har dushanba' degani.
